paper_title: Axion-like Relics: New Constraints from Old Comagnetometer Data
notes: Paper derives new constraints on ALP-neutron and ALP-electron couplings from re-analysis of decade-old comagnetometer data (Refs. [47-49]). The bounds are presented as shaded regions in Figs. 3 and 4. Data points extracted from figure descriptions and text statements of mass ranges and coupling limits. The paper claims strongest terrestrial constraints on ALP-neutron coupling over broad mass range (2.4×10^-17 eV ≲ m_a ≲ 4×10^-13 eV), comparable to stellar cooling bounds. DM density assumption ρ_a = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (all DM) and velocity v ≈ 7.7×10^-4 used throughout. Stochastic nature of ALP field accounted for via Monte Carlo. Confidence level 95% C.L. stated explicitly. Extraction confidence moderate (0.75) because exact numerical values from figures are approximate; paper provides mass ranges and qualitative bound descriptions rather than tabulated data points.
